selection_objective_note: Method/sizing selected on net-of-cost book-marginal ΔIR vs incumbent R05 (15bps deducted). R4-P3 enum compliant (net_ir; NOT raw sharpe). Overlay rejected on net_ir basis (ΔIR negative).
metric_type_global: design_stage_simulation (Return.portfolio 2-asset book; canonical_screen sleeve; NW lag-3 active-IR). NOT forge-authoritative. All decision numbers labeled; no proxy hand-calc (measurement-graduation §1). Authoritative backtest = forge build_bt_result.
hypothesis_under_test: 직교 diversifier sleeve + 국면 overlay + uncertainty 사이징으로 단일-sleeve(R05) book SR을 2.5로 돌파.
honest_headline_verdict: REJECT (thesis not supported). Overlay (β/regime de-risk + uncertainty sizing) does NOT meaningfully lift book SR/IR. Best achievable book SR ≈ 1.74 (vs incumbent R05 1.55, target 2.5) — gap NOT closed. The only durable, statistically-supported lever from this WT is a MODEST diversifier (ΔIR +0.05 at a=0.15, borderline) plus an OPTIONAL MDD-control overlay (MDD 34%→21% but ΔIR −0.08). Recommend DPL transition (measurement-graduation §5) — incremental sleeve+overlay tuning has a low ceiling here.
target_weights_note: These are the residual-mom SLEEVE-leg target weights at the latest sig_date 2026-05-31 (top-20 EW, Σw=1, max 0.05, long-only). EW selected over MVO/HRP/ERC (see method_comparison: Cycle-2 1/N rationale + lower turnover). The SLEEVE is one leg of a multi-sleeve book; the incumbent R05 leg is frozen book_state. Book-level allocation to this sleeve = book_allocation_to_sleeve below.

book_construction.structure: multi_sleeve (AX-007 EXCLUSION #1 — multi-sleeve, not single-sleeve top20)
book_construction.incumbent_leg: R05 (STR_1715_AR_on_M4_R05_overlay_PG2, book_state 100%) — FROZEN, optimizer does not re-weight it
book_construction.book_allocation_rationale: a=0.15 chosen: (1) ΔIR vs R05 = +0.049 (net, NW), the largest a with risk-acceptable tail; (2) a=0.20 gives ΔIR +0.067 but exposes book to the sleeve's -26.8% momentum-crash month (RF-R4) and the benefit is statistically uncertain (risk RX-2: ΔIR 95%CI straddles 0); conservative vol-aware sizing per risk sizing_guidance + RX-3 CVaR book cap. DeMiguel-Garlappi-Uppal 2009 1/N caution applied at both leg-internal (EW) and book level.
book_construction.effective_book_weights_per_name: = 0.15 * sleeve_weight (e.g. 0.0075 per name at full exposure). See weights.csv effective_book_weight column.

method_selected: STATIC_MULTISLEEVE_EW_a0.15 (overlay OFF for IR-optimal; optional regime de-risk overlay provided separately for MDD control)

method_comparison._basis: design_stage_simulation; SR = ann-return/ann-vol of book; ΔIR = net active-IR(vs KOSPI200 TR, NW lag-3) minus R05 incumbent IR 0.661; sleeve internal scheme on top-20.

sleeve_internal_scheme_comparison._note: internal weighting of the 20-name sleeve leg (standalone sleeve metrics).

EW.reason: 1/N OOS robustness (DeMiguel 2009) for broad 20-name alpha; lowest turnover among non-trivial schemes

MVO.reason: highest standalone SR BUT +47% turnover vs EW (20.6 vs 14.1) — net edge eroded at book sizing; concentration risk

HRP.reason: between EW and MVO; turnover penalty outweighs SR gain at small book allocation

ERC.reason: marginal SR gain over EW, higher turnover

a_0.20.note: ΔIR>0.05 but tail/uncertainty risk per RX-2/RX-3/RF-R4

overlay_comparison._note: THE WT CORE QUESTION — does β/regime overlay + uncertainty sizing lift book SR/IR? Applied on a=0.15 book.

regime_derisk_best_SR.note: SR ~= static a0.15 (1.70-1.72); NO meaningful SR lift, mainly vol/MDD cut

regime_derisk_active_IR.verdict: overlay HURTS active IR (forgoes alpha in benign months to cut vol). Good for MDD, bad for IR.

uncertainty_sizing.verdict: uncertainty haircut (μ̃=μ̂−k·SE) correctly de-allocates the statistically-weak sleeve as k rises (converges to R05). NO SR gain beyond a small static allocation — confirms risk RX-2 (edge not significant).

CONTROL_overlay_on_R05_alone.verdict: DECISIVE: same regime overlay applied to R05 ALONE gives SR 1.46-1.57 vs base 1.549 — NO lift or slight harm. The overlay machinery (crisis-prob/regime timing) has NO incremental SR alpha on this book because R05 is ALREADY M4 regime-overlaid. A second overlay layer is redundant.

method_log.name: overlay_uncertainty_sizing
method_log.reason: no lift; converges to R05 as k↑

book_marginal_dIR.meets_threshold_note: ΔIR +0.049 at a=0.15 is FRACTIONALLY BELOW the 0.05 book-marginal admission threshold (measurement-graduation §4). a=0.20 reaches +0.067 but is risk-disfavored. The diversifier is at the edge of marginal-admissibility; combined with statistically-uncertain benefit (risk RX-2: ΔIR 95%CI [-0.0149,+0.0056] straddles 0) and standalone alpha FAIL (port-α t 1.46), HONEST conclusion = borderline/weak, NOT a confident admit.
book_marginal_dIR.basis: net active-IR vs KOSPI200 TR forward-month, NW lag-3, n=267 overlap months, design-stage Return.portfolio. Forge must confirm authoritatively.

overlay_spec.rationale_for_off: On net_ir basis the overlay is NEGATIVE (ΔIR -0.083) and the CONTROL proves it adds no SR alpha to R05 alone (R05 already M4-overlaid). Silent application would inflate apparent risk control while degrading IR.

optional_mdd_control_overlay.signal: max(MSM_Crisis_Prob_lag, combined_regime) from R05 series (both t-1 lagged, PIT C5 compliant)
optional_mdd_control_overlay.rule: if signal >= 0.60 -> scale total book exposure to 0.30 (hold 0.70 cash), else 1.0
optional_mdd_control_overlay.uncertainty_k: not used in IR-optimal deliverable; k=1.0 reference de-allocates sleeve to avg 4.9%
optional_mdd_control_overlay.effect: MDD 0.345 -> 0.210, book_sr ~1.70 (flat), active_IR -0.083. Use ONLY if mandate prioritizes drawdown over IR. Forge/governor decision.

turnover_note: sleeve-leg one-way monthly 0.587 -> annual ROUND-TRIP 14.08 (= one-way × 12 × 2). EXCEEDS implementation discipline ceiling (P6: TO ≤ 11.0/yr round-trip). 15bps cost IS deducted (net ΔIR stays +0.049 > 0), so net>cost holds, BUT the turnover ceiling is breached. Flagged as RF-O implementation concern — NOT silently relaxed. Book-level turnover lower (sleeve is only 15% of book): book round-trip ≈ 0.15×14.08 + R05 turnover.

covariance_used.structural_sigma_status: ADVISORY only — risk RX-1 directed: structural BΩB'+D diagonal-D VIOLATED (residual off-diag |cor| 0.115, 81/1225 pairs >0.30). Used direct-LW per risk handoff_to_optimizer.covariance_for_optimization.
covariance_used.note: Σ used only for the internal sleeve-scheme comparison (MVO/HRP/ERC). Selected EW scheme does not require Σ. Book-level diversification driven by realized return co-movement (cov_contribution -0.0044, risk corisk).

red_flags.note: expected net active return 0.198 >> cost*2 (0.0042) — passes. But standalone sleeve alpha is weak (alpha port-α t 1.46).
sleeve turnover 14.08/yr round-trip > P6 ceiling 11.0. Net-of-cost ΔIR still positive but ceiling breached — flagged honestly, NOT relaxed.
book-marginal ΔIR +0.049 at a=0.15 is BELOW 0.05 admission threshold; statistically uncertain (risk RX-2). Borderline, not a confident admit.
WT central thesis (overlay lifts SR toward 2.5) REFUTED by data: overlay ΔIR -0.083; CONTROL (overlay on R05 alone) shows no SR lift (R05 already overlaid). Best book SR 1.74 << 2.5.

main_tradeoffs: EW chosen over MVO/HRP/ERC: 1/N OOS robustness + lowest turnover (Cycle-2 lesson — sizing did NOT beat EW net of turnover at book scale).
Overlay OFF in IR-optimal deliverable: it cuts MDD (34%→21%) but hurts active IR (-0.083) and adds no SR alpha (control-proven redundant with R05's existing M4 overlay).
a=0.15 (not 0.20): conservative vol-aware sizing given the sleeve's -26.8% momentum-crash tail and statistically-uncertain diversification benefit.

handoff_to_forge.honest_flag: Standalone sleeve FAILED graduation (port-α t 1.46). This handoff is a WEAK multi-sleeve diversifier (borderline ΔIR), NOT an SR-2.5 solution. Forge/judge/governor should weigh DPL transition recommendation.

honest_conclusion.does_overlay_lift_SR_toward_2.5: NO. Definitively refuted. Overlay (regime de-risk + uncertainty sizing) provides MDD control (34%→21%) but NO SR/IR lift; the control test (overlay on R05 alone, SR 1.46-1.57 vs 1.549) proves the overlay has no incremental alpha because R05 is already M4-overlaid. measurement-graduation §5 thesis 'overlay = SR 2.5 main lever' is NOT supported on this incumbent.
honest_conclusion.diversifier_value: Modest and borderline: book SR 1.55→1.70 (+0.15), ΔIR +0.049 (just below 0.05 threshold), statistically uncertain (risk RX-2). Real but small.
honest_conclusion.residual_mom_final_allocation: SMALL — book allocation 0.15 (per name effective ~0.0075), vol-aware per risk guidance.
honest_conclusion.recommendation: DPL TRANSITION (measurement-graduation §5). Incremental sleeve+overlay tuning has a low ceiling (~SR 1.74). The SR-2.5 gap requires direct portfolio learning (features→weights end-to-end, net-SR objective) OR a structurally different lever, not more two-stage sleeve stacking. Do NOT spin wheels tuning overlay parameters — the control test shows the ceiling is structural. Forge handoff prepared for the borderline diversifier; governor admit NOT recommended on ΔIR<0.05 + standalone FAIL.
